beats.text: 2 AM. Rain. A man running down Koti road, waving at every auto.
Only Salim stopped. In the back seat, the man's wife. In labour.
Salim drove through the empty city like it was his own family. He never switched the meter on.
Twenty-four years later, a young doctor waved down his auto outside the hospital.
"You won't remember me, uncle. You drove me here before I was born."
beats.small: Some fares get paid back late.

end.text: Who's the stranger your family still talks about?
